w: Swamishri paid a visit to see the performance of 'Sant Param Hitkari' by children at the Town Hall in Anand. Then Swamishri visited the newly constructed Swaminarayan mandir in Anand. In the evening, Swamishri briefly visited the Swaminarayan Nagar - festival site.

Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis to be installed in the newly built Swaminarayan Mandirs in Bhatpura (taluka: Umreth) and in Khanpur (taluka: Anand). After the rituals Swamishri performed the pratishtha arti. Then Swamishri blessed the devotees of the two villages.
Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees in the evening assembly.

A sadhu asked Swamishri, “You have worked with the sadhus of Shastriji Maharaj and today you also work with love with young sadhus like us. What is the secret behind this?” Swamishri replied, “I bow to all, look after everyone’s minds and never complain about anyone. By understanding everyone’s glory then things will be fine. If you understand others’ natures then you won’t have any problems.”
Swamishri consecrated the murtis for the new BAPS hari mandirs in Amalsadi and Sarbhan with rituals of pujan and arti.
Faith in god

19 November 2009, Bochasan In a telephone conversation with Swamishri a devotee asked for guidance, “My relative’s daughter likes a boy and wishes to marry him. The boy too has agreed. But the astrologer has forecasted that their marriage will break up after three months. What should we do?” Swamishri blessed the devotee, “Since you have firm faith in Shriji Maharaj chant the Janmangal paath five times every day. Any obstacle will be resolved. Everything will work out well. Chant Swaminarayan namaha, Sahajanandaya namaha. Have faith and trust and proceed ahead with their engagement and marriage.” Swamishri liberates devotees from obstacles by virtue of their firm faith in and prayers to God.
Five pledges

21 November 2009, Bochasan A devotee from Los Angeles asked Swamishri through a fax, “I do my puja daily, but to make me feel that you are with me give me five pledges to follow. I will observe them unfailingly.”
Key to resolving worldy desires
23 November 2009, Bochasan An aspirant requested Swamishri, “Bless me that my inner faults and nature get dissolved.” Swamishri replied briefly, “Read the Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato daily.”
Faith and bhajan

23 November 2009, Bochasan Swamishri was reading a fax from a devotee in America: Since the last eight years he has being going through severe trials at work, business and in other areas of life. He is facing a financial crisis. Physically and mentally he is going through one torturous problem after another. Swamishri was moved and said, “He is going through a severe test!” He blessed him, “It has pained me to know that you are facing problems in your business and personal life. You and your entire family have firm faith, understanding and satsang . Devotees of the past had unshaking refuge in God, yet they had to go through obstacles and suffering. So, be patient and do bhajan. Shriji Maharaj is the all-doer, and whatever he does is for your good. Maharaj will do good for you.”Swamishri sympathized with him and consolidated his patience and spiritual faith.

ds.t: Passing away at the time of mangala arti
w: Dilipbhai Trivedi, a dedicated and long standing satsangi of Mumbai, had come here to benefit from Pramukh Swami Maharaj's company. In particular, a three day parayan was going on, sponsored by him, and this morning suddenly at 5.45, right in the auspicious Brahma muhurt, while the morning devotional songs were being sung before the mangala arti, he passed away to Akshardham. For a while, until the doctor came, it was impossible to confirm this, and the mangala arti took place. Meanwhile, when the sadhus learnt of it, they sent youths, and when the door was opened, his wife was performing the mangala arti. Here one could see satsang with understanding and knowledge. To go to Akshardham without any kind of pain, in the Brahma muhurt, in the direct presence of Swamishri, at the time of the mangala arti, and moreover while a parayan sponsored by himself was going on, can only be called an auspicious event! Today such an event happened suddenly.

When Swamishri learnt that his wife and daughters wished that "the cremation too should be done in this very holy place", he instructed Vedagna Swami to make all kinds of arrangements. The satsangis themselves took on all the responsibilities.
Everyone saw a unique example of exclusive conviction, friendliness and being one family.
Today Hareshbhai Moradiya had come for a meeting with his brother Miteshbhai. Seeing them, Mahant Swami Maharaj asked, "Do you live here (Vidyanagar)?"
Hareshbhai said, "No Swami! He lives in Surat."
Swamishri asked, "Then who lives here?"
Everyone fell to thinking.
Making it clear, Swamishri said, "You made my first glasses."
Hareshbhai and Miteshbhai went deeper: "Yes Swami! Years ago our shop was here, in 1992! But even we had forgotten, and you remember!"

Today the 97th birth anniversary festival of Pramukh Swami Maharaj was celebrated here with great grandeur. When Mahant Swami Maharaj came from the festival venue to his residence, Brahmviharidas Swami brought the well known Arab industrialist Shri Nazim Khawaz Al Kutsi. As soon as he came, Shri Nazim fell at Swamishri's feet. He offered panchang pranam.
Brahmviharidas Swami said, "Swami! He believes this is the greatest moment of his life. He wants to express his feelings before you." Saying this, he asked Shri Nazim to speak.
Overcome with emotion, Nazim began to say in broken words, "Swamiji, Guru! I was afraid after Pramukh Swami left his body that the flow of energy to me would be cut, but tonight it came to me."
(Swamiji, Guru! When Pramukh Swami Maharaj left his body, I became afraid that the flow of inspiring energy I received from him would stop, but tonight I have received it again.)

Shri Nazim's voice had fallen silent and his eyes had begun to speak. Tears had welled up in his eyes. After a little conversation, as he took leave, Shri Nazim held Swamishri's feet and kept offering panchang pranam for a long time. Swamishri too gave him heartfelt blessings. Standing up and saying "Jai Swaminarayan... Jai Swaminarayan... Jai Swaminarayan..." to Swamishri and the sadhus, he went out of the room.

Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj sat down to take his meal, referring to today's festival assembly, Gunvatsaldas Swami said, "Today you sat for three and a half hours straight. You didn't even go to pass water in between."
Swamishri said, "I did 300 malas."
"Oh!" escaped from the sadhus' lips.
The attendant sadhu asked, "Did you remember Bapa?"
"Whom else is there to remember?" Then Swamishri said, "I did the mala continuously."

Who else in the festival assembly would have done 300 malas? Who would have constantly remembered Pramukh Swami Maharaj? Truly, it is Swamishri who celebrates the real birth anniversary of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
